At this point in history, Russia is divided into many different groups. You have different ethnicities, political programs, and orientations. This will launch the great civil war. Remember, the Bolsheviks only control a certain part of Russia. They are the official government but only control a small part. Meanwhile, the White Army, a combination of liberals and monarchists, has a much stronger military. Over the next five years, the Bolsheviks will obtain absolute power through terror—stealing as much money as possible from wealthy people by threatening to kill their families if they do not cooperate.

Leon Trotsky organized the Red Army in the war against the White Army. The Greens, made up of peasants, were also a factor. The Bolsheviks were far behind but had help from mercenaries, especially Chinese, Latvian, and Hungarian forces, funded by transnational capital—Wall Street and City of London—which supported the Soviets to threaten their debtors: Britain, Japan, United States, and France.

The Bolsheviks stole money from peasants, nobility, and the treasury to pay off these armies. These armies then helped them in the war against the White Army. This makes sense because American, British, and French support was not purely anti-communist but driven by their interests in recovering debts.

Summarizing what we've learned: History class teaches that Britain and America need Russia to fight Germany, supporting the Bolsheviks to counter German influence. However, transnational capital influences Anglo-American foreign policy for profit rather than ideology. The Bolsheviks are seen as a threat but prioritize power over ideology, believing in the ends justify the means.

This is a book called "Wall Street and the Russian Revolution."
